shortlist.diversity_rule: greedy deterministic selection with at most 4 states per config before any remaining slots; require at least 3 configs when class availability permits

final.diversity_rule: greedy deterministic selection with at most 3 states per config; require at least 3 configs per class

class_certainty_score.WIDEN_SHRINK: minimum normalized slack over improvement threshold, direction-margin threshold, and required paired-support threshold
class_certainty_score.HOLD: minimum normalized distance of both arm/base ratios from the +/-0.03 HOLD boundary
